blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Peasant and left-leaning groups have launched a monthlong campaign opposing US President Donald Trump’s planned Manila visit for the Asean Summit, citing concerns over US military and economic activities and their impact on farmers’ land, livelihoods and food security. Dubbed “TRUMP OUT! Lupa sa magsasaka, hindi sa imperyalista!,” the campaign seeks to explain why the groups oppose Trump’s visit, which they say comes amid continuing US military, political and economic intervention in the Philippines. The initiative, part of a multisectoral effort led by Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (BAYAN), involves distributing leaflets and comics in public cemeteries, transport terminals, markets […]...
